title: 2024 TOPPS SERIES 1 Oneil CRUZ RAINBOW FOIL #90 Pittsburgh Pirates
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024 Topps Series 1 trading card featuring Oneil Cruz of the Pittsburgh Pirates. The card is a Rainbow Foil parallel/variety, with a card number of 90. It belongs to the category of Trading Card Singles and falls under the Sports Trading Cards and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop categories. The card is perfect for collectors who are fans of baseball and the Major League (MLB). The card is manufactured by Topps and is part of the 2024 season set.
